root_cause: FAULT=latency is active. Every non-health request is delayed by 500–3000 ms in the HTTP middleware before processing, and 40% of requests to /products and /orders are randomly terminated with HTTP 500. This causes the Prometheus P99 latency to exceed 2000 ms and the error rate to exceed 40%, both well above the alerting thresholds.
contributing_factors: FAULT=latency injects random 500–3000 ms sleep in the HTTP middleware
40% of requests randomly return HTTP 500 via _maybe_500()
P99 latency spikes above 2000 ms threshold
Error rate rises above 40% — exceeds the 10% critical threshold
Health endpoint unaffected (excluded from fault injection)
evidence: Application logs: multiple 500 responses on /products and /orders
GET /health returns 200 — pod is alive, not OOMKilled
No recent deployment or config change

remediation.recommendation: Disable the latency fault (FAULT=none) to immediately restore normal response times and error rates.
steps: POST /fault with body {"fault": "none"} or redeploy with FAULT=none
Verify P99 latency drops below 200 ms and error rate below 1%
Review Prometheus dashboards for any residual errors
Add circuit breakers or timeouts in the API gateway layer for production hardening
